name: v2.1.0
body:
GLiNER2 2.1.0 is on PyPI. Paste the note below into a Hugging Face model card or discussion.

```markdown
# GLiNER2 2.1.0

Released 9 October 2026. Install with:

```bash
pip install -U "gliner2==2.1.0"
```

This is the library release after [gliner2 2.0.0](https://pypi.org/project/gliner2/2.0.0/) (24 August 2026, the GLiNER2.5 release). It is built from [fastino-ai/GLiNER2](https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2) `main` at `b86d35c`. Checkpoint weights are unchanged. What changed is inference, training, schemas, and packaging.

Full history: [v2.0.0...b86d35c](https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/compare/v2.0.0...b86d35c)

## Highlights

- **Transformers 5.** `transformers>=4.43,<6` on every install profile. The `disentangled-flash` extra requires `transformers>=4.57,<6`.
- **DisentangledFlash attention** for DeBERTa encoders, including an automatic packed (unpadded) path and a differentiable training path.
- **Faster span scoring and decoder synchronization.**
- **Schemas from JSON now match the Python builder**, including thresholds, `top_k`, label descriptions, prompts, and few-shot examples.
- **Precomputed encoder states** can be passed into every batch inference API, and a boundary model can be loaded without the encoder.
- Training fixes for gold-label corruption, Indic tokenization, phantom entity spans, half-precision NaNs, record choice fields, and LoRA unload.

## Faster inference

### DisentangledFlash

New load option `attention_backend`:

| Value | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `"standard"` | Transformers attention |
| `"flashdeberta"` | FlashDeBERTa. `use_flashdeberta` remains a compatibility alias |
| `"disentangled_flash"` | [DisentangledFlash](https://github.com/delyan-boychev/disentangled-flash) |

```python
from gliner2 import GLiNER2

model = GLiNER2.from_pretrained(
    "fastino/gliner2-base-v1",
    attention_backend="disentangled_flash",
)
```

Install the extra with `pip install "gliner2[disentangled-flash]"`. On CUDA, FP16 or BF16 is what makes the flash kernels pay off.

Packed layout is on by default in auto mode. A batch uses the unpadded kernel when padding is at least 15% and the batch is large enough (`B * L**2 >= 2**21`, measured on an H200). Smaller batches stay on the padded path. Tune it with `disentangled_flash_packed`, `disentangled_flash_min_padding`, `disentangled_flash_min_work`, and `disentangled_flash_tuning`.

`attention_backend="disentangled_flash"` cannot be combined with `compile=True`. The same backend is available for training through `enable_disentangled_flash()`.

### Decoder and serving

Span scoring and boundary/accelerator decoder synchronization are tighter. On the serving path, `peft` and the trainer are imported only when LoRA or training collation actually needs them, so an extraction image can import the model without `peft`. `SchemaTransformer.transform_record(text, schema, max_len=)` is now public.

## Schemas and inference

### `Schema.from_dict`

A JSON schema now accepts the same options as the builder and rejects unknown keys.

- Classification: `cls_threshold` (0–1), `top_k` (>= 1), labels as a label-to-description dict, `class_act`, `prompt`, and few-shot examples. `top_k` keeps the highest-probability labels.
- Entities: per-type `description`, `dtype`, and `threshold`.
- Relations: per-type `description` and `threshold`.
- Fields: `threshold`.
- `entity_attributes` follows `AttributeGroup` and requires `entities`.
- `to_dict()` writes these options back and lists only declared entities.

### Precomputed encoder states

`encode_tokens(batch, hidden_states=None)` is the only inference call into the encoder. Batch extract, classify, and score accept `hidden_states=`. Given one `(tokens, hidden)` tensor per row, the states are checked against the attention mask and right-padded. `BoundaryExtractorModel(load_encoder=False)` builds the heads only. Classifier batch APIs accept one schema per text.

### Records, relations, and classification decode

- **Choice fields stay per record.** Enum tokens that live only in the schema prefix (for example `sentiment(positive|negative|neutral)`) used to be discarded, so every record in a document fell back to one shared answer. Each record now keeps the choice assigned to that instance.
- **Relation and record confidence** is reported at the relation or record level, not borrowed from a lower span.
- **Explicit character spans** are accepted in training gold and scored with the shared pool scorer.
- A two-element classification value is read as `(label, score)` only when the first item is a string and the second is a non-bool number. `["tech", "finance"]` stays a two-label list, including after a JSON round-trip.
- **Constraints no longer override a valid answer.** If the unconstrained decode already satisfies a constraint, adding that constraint keeps the same result. A rescued label can only add candidates. It no longer pins an exclusive task to a label that was below the floor.
- When beam search runs out of node budget, it returns infeasible instead of an empty solution that looked feasible. A truncated min-violations search reports `exact=False`.

### Loading

Decide checkpoints are documented in the model tables:

- [`fastino/GLiNER2.5-Decide`](https://huggingface.co/fastino/GLiNER2.5-Decide) — English classification, span, DeBERTa-v3-large
- [`fastino/GLiNER2.5-multi-Decide`](https://huggingface.co/fastino/GLiNER2.5-multi-Decide) — multilingual classification, boundary, mDeBERTa-v3-base

Loading a DeBERTa checkpoint no longer prints the TorchScript future warning, the expected SDPA-to-eager fallback, or the config banner. An explicit `flash_attention_2` request that falls back still warns.

The hosted client reads **`FASTINO_API_KEY` only**. `PIONEER_API_KEY` is no longer accepted. Sign-up and hosted fine-tuning docs point at [agent.fastino.ai](https://agent.fastino.ai).

## Training

### Fixes that change supervision

- **Gold label trained as a negative.** When synthetic label renaming and true-label reinsertion both ran, the real label was put back under its original name while `true_label` pointed at the synthetic name. With the default sampler this hit about a quarter of training views. A string `true_label` was also split into characters. Both are fixed.
- **Indic and other combining-mark scripts.** `WhitespaceTokenSplitter` treated vowel signs, viramas, and similar marks as word breaks, so Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, and related text was cut apart before span selection. Combining marks and ZWJ/ZWNJ now stay inside the word. Text without those marks splits as before.
- **Phantom contained gold spans.** If one entity type listed both `Kiox` and `Kiox 300`, the short value was also matched inside every longer mention. Entity gold now keeps the longest non-contained span. This is on by default (`dedupe_contained_entity_spans=True`) and applies to entity queries only, so record and relation targets stay aligned with their own span lists. Set it to `False` to restore the old matches.
- **Unalignable entities.** A character substring can still fail token alignment when a hyphen or underscore run is one token (`ABS` inside `LEDRemote-ABS-BES3-MY2023.png`). The error now includes the listed value and a text snippet. Check a corpus before training with `SchemaTransformer.find_unalignable_entities(text, entities)`.
- **Half-precision NaNs.** `marginal_pair_consistency_loss` clamped probabilities with `1e-6`. In fp16 and bf16 that clamp rounds away, `log1p(-1)` becomes infinite, and the backward pass writes NaNs into the encoder. The floor is now the dtype epsilon. Float32 is unchanged. This matters because consistency loss and fp16 are both on by default.
- **Empty NER rows.** A row with no mentions is a valid negative when the types are declared. Keys in `entity_descriptions` now count as that label set, so a described type with an empty mention list trains as all-negative. A row with no types and no other task still fails.
- **Record anchor.** Sanitizing an example could drop the field named by `record_metadata` and either abort inside a DataLoader worker or silently retarget the anchor to another field. If the anchor does not survive, the whole structure is dropped.
- **Eval-loss fallback records.** A malformed eval row no longer crashes `build_boundary_batch_metadata` with `TypeError`, and substituting a fallback record is logged instead of silent.

### LoRA and dependencies during training

- Full fine-tuning no longer imports `peft`. A missing `peft` install raises `ImportError` only on a LoRA path, and the message names the extra to install.
- `unload_lora_adapter()` removes LoRA layers even when `load_adapter()` injected them in place and the module was never wrapped as a `PeftModel`. After unload, forwards match the base model again.

## Packaging

| Extra | Notable bounds |
| --- | --- |
| base | `transformers` is not required. Schemas, the API client, and training-data helpers stay torch-free |
| `local`, `train`, `dev` | `transformers>=4.43,<6`, `torch>=2.1,<3` |
| `train`, `dev` | `sentencepiece>=0.2,<1` and `protobuf>=4,<8`, required to build a tokenizer from a raw DeBERTa-v3 `spm.model` |
| `disentangled-flash` | `disentangled-flash>=1.1,<2`, `transformers>=4.57,<6` |

Other caps moved up to current releases: `setuptools<85`, `pytest<10`, `mypy<3`, `twine<8`, `datasets<6`. If a tokenizer dependency is missing, the error names `sentencepiece` and `protobuf` instead of Transformers' tiktoken message.

Python support remains 3.10–3.12.

## Upgrade notes

- Set `FASTINO_API_KEY`. `PIONEER_API_KEY` is ignored.
- Retrain or expect different entity targets if your gold listed both a short string and a longer string that contains it. That filter is now the default.
- `pip install "gliner2[train]"` on a fresh environment pulls `sentencepiece` and `protobuf`.
- A Transformers install older than 4.43 no longer satisfies the package metadata.
```

## What's Changed
* Run ruff format on the serving-path files (no behavioral change) by @MattThomas-fastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/146
* Fix classification decoding edge cases on node-budget exhaustion by @gustavohra in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/152
* Fix NaN gradients from marginal_pair_consistency_loss in half precision by @whr778 in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/155
* Fix TypeError in build_boundary_batch_metadata for fallback records under eval-loss by @jaanavit in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/153
* Fix choice/enum record fields collapsing to one document-wide answer by @jaanavit in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/158
* Serving-path import surface: GRU hoist, public transform_record, peft-free imports, no true_label sentinels by @MattThomas-fastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/144
* Use FASTINO_API_KEY for the API client by @javi-fastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/171
* docs: document hosted fine-tuning via the Fastino API by @javi-fastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/170
* docs: point Fastino sign-up links to agent.fastino.ai by @javi-fastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/172
* Quiet model load: drop non-actionable warnings and config banner by @kfastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/175
* Accept precomputed encoder hidden states on every batch inference API by @MattThomas-fastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/164
* Make Schema.from_dict cover the whole builder by @MattThomas-fastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/165
* docs: add Decide classification checkpoints to the README model list by @bhushankinge in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/174
* Accept explicit character spans in training gold by @bulatovv in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/177
* Add DisentangledFlash as an optional DeBERTa attention backend by @delyan-boychev in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/182
* Fix word splitting for Indic scripts: keep combining marks inside words by @nishikantmandal007 in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/186
* Accept NER negatives whose label set comes from entity descriptions by @hfastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/168
* Report relation and record confidence at their own level by @bulatovv in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/176
* Score explicit spans with the shared pool scorer by @bulatovv in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/179
* Fix constrained classification changing the answer under a constraint the unconstrained optimum already satisfies by @hfastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/167
* Import peft only on LoRA code paths so non-LoRA training works without it by @hfastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/169
* Fix unload_lora_adapter() silent no-op when model is not a PeftModel by @jaanavit in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/160
* Keep a structure's record-metadata anchor through sanitization by @whr778 in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/161
* Fix boundary entity alignment errors and phantom contained gold spans by @jaanavit in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/181
* Optimize span scoring by @delyan-boychev in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/143
* Fix classification augmentation training the gold label as a negative by @kfastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/187
* Optimize decoder CPU synchronization by @delyan-boychev in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/188
* Support Transformers 5 and refresh dependency caps by @MattThomas-fastino in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/189

## New Contributors
* @gustavohra made their first contribution in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/152
* @whr778 made their first contribution in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/155
* @jaanavit made their first contribution in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/153
* @javi-fastino made their first contribution in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/171
* @kfastino made their first contribution in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/175
* @bhushankinge made their first contribution in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/174
* @bulatovv made their first contribution in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/177
* @delyan-boychev made their first contribution in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/182
* @nishikantmandal007 made their first contribution in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/186
* @hfastino made their first contribution in https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/pull/168

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0
